templates.why_chosen: The tensor operator graph (op1 and op2 merging into op3) and the per-device training DAG sit as small inline glyphs beside the four-step App/Comm Layer stack they illustrate, at high confidence.
templates.what_to_learn: Place a small branching operator graph and a per-device schedule diagram beside the pipeline stage that emits them rather than inside the stage box, and keep the layer-group brackets (App Layer, Comm Layer) tight against the boxes they enclose, since this exemplar lets them drift visually apart.
